title: GRB 220101A: a most energetic $10^{54}$ erg long GRB triggered by two supernovae 3.5 seconds apart
summary: GRB 220101A is a long GRB, with a total energy exceeding $10^{54}$ erg with a redshift $z = 4.61$ and one of the largest ever high-quality multi-wavelength observational coverage, from a large number of space-based and ground-based telescopes. We interpret this source in a doubly Binary driven peta nova (BdP-N) model. The progenitor is composed of a massive CO core of $\sim 10\,M_\odot$, highly magnetized with $B \sim 10^{6}$ G, associated to a neutron star (NS) and a white dwarf (WD) with orbital periods from minutes to hours. The large GRB luminosity is explained by a sequence of 7 episodes: episode 1 is triggered by a new kind of pair supernova (HB) which originates from the collapse of the strongly magnetized CO core. Accretion of the HB supernova ejecta (the ejecta) onto the white dwarf companion triggers after 3.5 sec the episode 2: the second supernova emitting neutrinos and creating a new neutron star ($ν$NS). The ejecta, interacting with the magnetosphere of the binary NS companion originate the episode 3: the Ultra relativistic Prompt Emission (UPE) emission by far the most energetic episode of this GRB, with the formation of a powerful jet normal to the plane of the GRB. Following the UPE energy loss, the accretion of the ejecta on the NS companion leads to the episode 4: the formation of a black hole (BH) of $2.3 \ M_\odot$ leading to the observed GeV afterglow emission. Further accretion of the ejecta spin up the $ν$NS to a period of $1.3$ ms which gives origin to the episode 5: the birth of a pulsar. The interaction of this milli-second pulsar with the remnants lead to the Episode 6: the synchrotron emission observed in the X-ray, optical and radio, The episode 7 is a 56.7 ms pulsar, as observed $10^{10}$ s after the first burst in the crab nebula.

AI.abstract_translation: GRB 220101A 是一个长 GRB，其总能量超过 $10^{54}$ erg，红移 $z = 4.61$，并拥有迄今最大规模的高质量多波段观测覆盖之一，来自大量天基和地基望远镜。我们在此源的“双重双星驱动的皮秒新星（BdP-N）”模型中对其进行解读。前身天体由一个质量约为 $10\,M_\odot$ 的大质量 CO 核组成，具有强磁场，$B \sim 10^{6}$ G，并伴有一颗中子星（NS）和一颗白矮星（WD），轨道周期从几分钟到几小时。该 GRB 的巨大光度由一系列 7 个阶段解释：阶段 1 由一种新型的“对超新星”（HB）触发，它源于强磁化 CO 核的坍缩。HB 超新星抛射物（即抛射物）吸积到白矮星伴星上，在 3.5 秒后触发阶段 2：第二次超新星，它发射中微子并诞生一颗新的中子星（$ν$NS）。抛射物与双星中的 NS 伴星的磁层相互作用产生阶段 3：宇宙相对论性瞬发辐射（UPE）发射，这是该 GRB 中迄今为止能量最高的阶段，并形成一个垂直于 GRB 平面的强大喷流。在 UPE 能量损失之后，抛射物在 NS 伴星上的吸积导致阶段 4：形成一个质量为 $2.3 \ M_\odot$ 的黑洞（BH），从而产生观测到的 GeV 余辉发射。抛射物的进一步吸积使 $ν$NS 自转加速至 $\sim 1.3$ ms 的周期，由此产生阶段 5：一颗脉冲星的诞生。这颗毫秒脉冲星与残留物的相互作用导致阶段 6：在 X 射线、光学和射电波段观测到的同步辐射。阶段 7 是一颗周期为 56.7 ms 的脉冲星，如在第一次爆发后 $10^{10}$ s 时在蟹状星云中所观测到的那样。
AI.tldr: GRB 220101A 是一个总能量超过 $10^{54}$ erg、红移 $z=4.61$ 的长 GRB，论文用七阶段的双重双星驱动皮秒新星（BdP-N）模型解释其巨大光度，包括两次相隔 3.5 秒的超新星、UPE 发射、黑洞形成、毫秒脉冲星诞生及 56.7 ms 脉冲星等阶段。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在解释 GRB 220101A 这一极高能量（超过 $10^{54}$ erg）长 GRB 的极端光度起源，并以 BdP-N 模型提出由两次相隔 3.5 秒的超新星触发的前身天体物理图景，填补此类极端能量事件辐射机制的认识空白。
AI.method: 摘要说明该源拥有来自大量天基和地基望远镜的高质量多波段观测覆盖。分析采用 BdP-N 模型，将前身天体描述为约 $10\,M_\odot$、$B\sim10^{6}$ G 的强磁化 CO 核，伴 NS 与 WD（轨道周期分钟至小时级），并划分为 7 个演化阶段进行解释。摘要未说明具体观测频率、时间跨度或数据分析技术细节。
AI.result: 摘要报告了 7 个阶段：HB 对超新星坍缩触发阶段 1；抛射物吸积于 3.5 秒后触发阶段 2 的第二次超新星并产生 $ν$NS；抛射物与 NS 磁层相互作用产生阶段 3 的 UPE 射电（最能量高）；阶段 4 形成 $2.3\ M_\odot$ 黑洞并产生 GeV 余辉；$ν$NS 自转加速至 1.3 ms 诞生脉冲星（阶段 5）；与残留物作用产生 X 射线、光学和射电同步辐射（阶段 6）；阶段 7 为首次爆发后 $10^{10}$ s 在蟹状星云观测到的 56.7 ms 脉冲星。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：BdP-N 模型能以两次相隔 3.5 秒的超新星及其后续吸积、喷流形成、黑洞形成和毫秒脉冲星诞生这一七阶段序列，合理解释 GRB 220101A 超过 $10^{54}$ erg 的巨大光度和多波段观测特征。摘要未明确给出该外推到脉冲星/磁星/FRB 研究的方法论适用性，因此无法判断。

title: Pulse profiles of accreting neutron stars - A review of analysis methods, observations, and theoretical models
comment: 171 pages, 23 Figures, 777 references. Submitted for publication in Space Science Reviews. This is the authors' version having responded to the comments raised by the referees
summary: X-ray pulsars are highly magnetized ($B\sim 10^{12}$ G) neutron stars accreting from a donor star. Their characteristic X-ray emission arises from accreted material decelerated from relativistic velocities near the magnetic poles of the neutron star. As our line of sight onto the magnetic poles changes with the rotation of the neutron star, the X-rays are periodically modulated, resulting in X-ray pulsations. The shape of the pulse profiles depends on the physics of the interaction between the bright X-rays from the magnetic poles with the infalling matter, the location of the magnetic poles on the neutron star with respect to its spin axis, and on the properties of the space-time around the neutron star. In this review we give a pedagogical introduction to the accretion mechanisms operating in the various types of accreting neutron star systems and the observational techniques used to characterize the pulse profiles. We summarize how the pulse profiles depend on X-ray luminosity and energy and discuss the attempts to connect theoretically these observables with the physical accretion mechanisms. We conclude with an outline of future observational needs and further developments for theoretical models of magnetic accretion.

AI.abstract_translation: X射线脉冲星是高度磁化的（$B\sim 10^{12}$ G）中子星，它们从伴星吸积物质。其特征性的X射线辐射源于吸积物质在靠近中子星磁极处以相对论速度减速。当我们对磁极的视线随中子星的自转而变化时，X射线受到周期性调制，从而产生X射线脉冲。脉冲轮廓（pulse profile）的形状取决于来自磁极的明亮X射线与下落物质相互作用的物理过程、磁极在中子星上相对于其自转轴的位置，以及中子星周围时空的性质。在本综述中，我们对各类吸积中子星系统中运行的吸积机制以及用于表征脉冲轮廓的观测技术给出了教学性的介绍。我们总结了脉冲轮廓如何依赖于X射线光度与能量，并讨论了在理论上将这些可观测量与物理吸积机制联系起来的尝试。最后，我们概述了未来的观测需求以及磁吸积理论模型的进一步发展方向。
AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，系统介绍吸积X射线脉冲星（$B\sim 10^{12}$ G中子星）的脉冲轮廓形成机制、表征其轮廓的观测技术，以及脉冲轮廓随X射线光度和能量的依赖关系，并总结从理论上将可观测量与磁吸积机制联系起来的尝试与未来展望。

title: Hyperonic compact stars with vector portal dark matter
summary: The appearance of hyperons in the core of neutron stars generally softens the equation of state (EOS), posing a longstanding challenge to the existence of observed two-solar-mass compact stars. We investigate whether repulsive interactions mediated by a dark-sector vector portal can provide an additional source of high-density pressure and thereby modify the structure of hyperonic compact stars. The baryonic sector is described within the modified quark-meson coupling (MQMC) model, in which the octet baryons are treated as confined relativistic constituent-quark systems interacting self-consistently through the $σ$, $ω$, and $ρ$ fields within a mean field approximation. The dark sector consists of a fermionic dark matter coupled to baryonic matter through a neutral vector mediator $Z^\prime$, generating an additional repulsive contribution to the dense-matter EOS. We investigate the resulting equation of state, mass--radius relation, tidal deformability, and moment of inertia. The resulting mass--radius relations satisfy the observational bounds from massive pulsars, including PSR J0740 + 6620, with maximum neutron star masses reaching approximately $2 M_{\odot}$. The resulting changes in tidal and rotational observables provide additional avenues for testing the dark-sector interaction through multimessenger observations.

AI.abstract_translation: 中子星核心中超子的出现通常会软化状态方程（EOS），对观测到的两倍太阳质量致密星的存在构成长期挑战。我们研究暗扇区矢量门户所介导的排斥性相互作用能否提供一种额外的高密度压力来源，从而改变超子致密星的结构。重子扇区在修正夸克—介子耦合（MQMC）模型框架下加以描述，其中八重态重子被处理为受限的相对论性组分夸克系统，并在平均场近似中通过 $σ$、$ω$ 和 $ρ$ 场自洽地相互作用。暗扇区由费米子暗物质组成，它通过中性的矢量媒介子 $Z^\prime$ 与重子物质耦合，从而在致密物质状态方程中产生额外的排斥性贡献。我们研究了由此得到的状态方程、质量—半径关系、潮汐形变率以及转动惯量。所得的质量—半径关系满足来自大质量脉冲星（包括 PSR J0740 + 6620）的观测约束，最大中子星质量达到约 $2 M_{\odot}$。潮汐与转动可观测量所产生的相应变化为通过多信使观测检验暗扇区相互作用提供了额外途径。

AI.motivation: 核心出现超子会软化中子星的状态方程（EOS），对观测到的两倍太阳质量致密星的存在构成长期挑战。本文探讨暗扇区矢量门户介导的排斥性相互作用能否提供额外的高密度压力来源，从而修改超子致密星的结构。
AI.method: 重子扇区采用修正夸克—介子耦合（MQMC）模型，将八重态重子处理为受限的相对论性组分夸克系统，并在平均场近似中经 $σ$、$ω$、$ρ$ 场自洽相互作用；暗扇区为通过中性矢量媒介子 $Z^\prime$ 与重子物质耦合的费米子暗物质，从而在状态方程中增加排斥性贡献。研究内容包括状态方程、质量—半径关系、潮汐形变率与转动惯量。
AI.result: 所得质量—半径关系满足来自大质量脉冲星（包括 PSR J0740 + 6620）的观测约束，最大中子星质量达到约 $2 M_{\odot}$；潮汐与转动可观测量（潮汐形变率、转动惯量）发生了变化，为检验暗扇区相互作用提供了途径。
AI.conclusion: 暗扇区矢量门户介导的排斥性相互作用可为超子致密星提供额外的高密度压力，从而在状态方程软化的情况下仍能支撑约 $2 M_{\odot}$ 的最大质量，并满足现有观测约束。这些潮汐与转动观测量的变化可为通过多信使观测检验暗扇区相互作用提供额外途径。该结论属于致密星结构模型层面；摘要未涉及脉冲星单脉冲、磁星或FRB等观测主题，相关推断根据摘要无法判断。

title: Constraining neutron-star properties with ensembles of thermonuclear bursts: application to SRGA J144459.2-604207
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables; submitted to PASA. Supporting data and code at https://doi.org/10.26180/33065816
summary: Deducing the properties of the host neutron stars from thermonuclear (type-I) X-ray bursts remains a challenge, due to incomplete data, multidimensional parameter space, and dearth of suitable models and analysis tools. Here we describe further development of the BEANSP package, with a new "ensemble" analysis mode utilising the consistent and regular "clocked" bursting exhibited by some sources. This mode requires only one model evaluation per epoch, and so is much more efficient than the previous "train" mode. We apply the code to the best-known source exhibiting "clocked" bursting, GS 1826-24, utilising a grid of KEPLER models pre-calculated for this purpose, and find good agreement with a previous study. We performed experiments on simulated data, and recovered input parameters related to the burst ignition with reasonable accuracy, but less so for the system distance, emission anisotropy and neutron star mass and radius. Finally, we assembled a set of 14 daily burst epochs covering the 2024 outburst of the accretion-powered millisecond pulsar SRGA J144459.2-604207, and attempted to constrain the system properties of this object by comparing to SETTLE model predictions. We find reasonably good agreement between the observations and model predictions for a mildly sub-solar fuel composition, with H-fraction $X\approx0.54$ and CNO metallicity $Z_{\rm CNO}\approx0.01$. However, we note that the inferred H-fraction is in excess of the limit of 0.4 established separately, and the adopted model may not provide sufficiently accurate predictions for this burst ignition regime. The inferred distance depends on assumptions about the system inclination and corresponding anisotropy of the persistent emission, and is likely in the range 6-11 kpc. Future applications with more physically realistic models are a promising avenue for this and other sources with H-rich bursts.

AI.abstract_translation: 从热核（I型）X射线暴推断宿主中子星的性质仍然是一项挑战，原因是数据不完整、参数空间是多维的，以及缺乏合适的模型和分析工具。这里我们描述了BEANSP软件包的进一步开发，新增了一种"ensemble"（整体）分析模式，利用了某些源表现出的一致而规律的"clocked"（时钟式）暴发行为。这种模式每个历元只需一次模型评估，因此比之前的"train"（训练）模式效率高得多。我们将该程序应用于表现出"clocked"暴发行为的最著名源GS 1826-24，利用为此目的预先计算的KEPLER模型网格，发现与此前的一项研究具有良好的一致性。我们在模拟数据上进行了实验，以合理的精度恢复了与暴发点火相关的输入参数，但对于系统距离、发射各向异性以及中子星质量和半径的恢复则不那么好。最后，我们汇编了覆盖吸积驱动的毫秒脉冲星SRGA J144459.2-604207在2024年暴发期间的一组14个每日暴发历元，并尝试通过将其与SETTLE模型预测进行比较来约束该对象的系统性质。我们发现，对于轻度低于太阳的燃料成分，即H丰度$X\approx0.54$和CNO金属丰度$Z_{\rm CNO}\approx0.01$，观测与模型预测之间存在相当好的一致性。然而，我们注意到推断出的H丰度超过了单独确立的0.4的上限，并且所采用的模型可能无法为该暴发点火机制提供足够准确的预测。推断出的距离取决于关于系统倾角以及相应的持续发射各向异性的假设，并且可能在6-11 kpc范围内。未来应用更具物理现实性的模型，对于该源以及其他具有富H暴发的源来说是一条有前景的途径。
AI.tldr: 本文扩展了BEANSP软件包，新增"ensemble"整体分析模式，利用"clocked"热核暴发来约束中子星性质，并以吸积驱动毫秒脉冲星SRGA J144459.2-604207的2024年暴发（14个历元）为例，得出轻度低于太阳燃料成分（$X\approx0.54$，$Z_{\rm CNO}\approx0.01$）与观测较为吻合，距离可能在6-11 kpc。
AI.motivation: 从热核（I型）X射线暴推断中子星宿主性质仍因数据不完整、多维参数空间以及缺乏合适模型和分析工具而困难。作者开发了BEANSP的"ensemble"分析模式以提高效率，并探索其应用于约束源的性质。
AI.method: 描述BEANSP软件包的"ensemble"分析模式开发，该模式每历元只需一次模型评估。应用于"clocked"暴发源GS 1826-24，使用预计算的KEPLER模型网格，并与此前研究比较。在模拟数据上开展实验恢复点火参数。汇编SRGA J144459.2-604207在2024年暴发期间的14个每日暴发历元，与SETTLE模型预测比较。
AI.result: 与GS 1826-24此前研究结果良好一致；模拟实验中点火相关输入参数恢复合理，但系统距离、发射各向异性、中子星质量和半径恢复较差。对SRGA J144459.2-604207，观测与轻度低于太阳燃料成分（$X\approx0.54$，$Z_{\rm CNO}\approx0.01$）的模型预测相当吻合，但推断H丰度超过单独确立的0.4上限；推断距离可能在6-11 kpc，取决于倾角和发射各向异性假设。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为，对于具有富H暴发的源（包括SRGA J144459.2-604207），使用更具物理现实性的模型进行未来应用是有前景的方向。同时指出所采用的模型可能无法为这一暴发点火机制提供足够准确的预测，且对源的约束受限于假设条件。

summary: The maximal gravitational mass of nonrotating neutron stars (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>TOV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>) is one of the key parameters of compact objects and only loose bounds can be set based on the first principle. With reliable measurements of the masses and/or radii of the neutron stars, <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>TOV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> can be robustly inferred from either the mass distribution of these objects or the reconstruction of the equation of state of the very dense matter. For the first time we take the advantages of both two approaches to have a precise inference of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>M</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>TOV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>2.2</mml:mn><mml:msubsup><mml:mrow><mml:mn>5</mml:mn></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.07</mml:mn></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.08</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msubsup><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>M</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>⊙</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> (68.3% credibility), with the updated neutron star mass measurement sample, the mass-tidal deformability data of GW170817, the mass-radius data of PSR <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>J</mml:mi><mml:mn>0030</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>0451</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> and PSR <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>J</mml:mi><mml:mn>0740</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>6620</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>, as well as the theoretical information from the chiral effective theory and perturbative quantum chromodynamics (pQCD) at low- and very high-energy densities, respectively. This narrow credible range is benefited from the suppression of the high <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>TOV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> by the pQCD constraint and the exclusion of the low <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>TOV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> by the mass function. Three different EoS reconstruction methods are adopted separately, and the resulting <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>TOV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> and <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>R</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>TOV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> are found to be almost identical, where <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>R</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>TOV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>11.9</mml:mn><mml:msubsup><mml:mn>0</mml:mn><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.60</mml:mn></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>0.63</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msubsup><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>km</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> is the radius of the most massive nonrotating neutron star. This precisely evaluated <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>M</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>TOV</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula> suggests that the EoS of neutron star matter is just moderately stiff and the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mo>∼</mml:mo><mml:mn>2.5</mml:mn><mml:mi>─</mml:mi><mml:mn>3</mml:mn><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>M</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mo>⊙</mml:mo></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> compact objects detected by the second-generation gravitational wave detectors are most likely the lightest black holes.

AI.abstract_translation: 非转动中子星的最大引力质量（\(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\)）是致密天体的关键参数之一，而基于第一性原理只能给出松散的约束。凭借中子星质量及/或半径的可靠测量，\(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 可以从这些天体的质量分布或对极稠密物质状态方程的重建中得到稳健的推断。我们首次同时利用这两种方法的优势，对 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}=2.25_{-0.07}^{+0.08} M_{\odot}\)（68.3% 置信度）进行了精确推断，所用数据包括更新的中子星质量测量样本、GW170817的质量—潮汐形变数据、PSR J0030+0451和PSR J0740+6620的质量—半径数据，以及来自手征有效理论和微扰量子色动力学（pQCD）分别在低能量密度和极高能量密度下的理论信息。这一较窄的置信区间得益于 pQCD 约束对高 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 的抑制以及质量函数对低 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 的排除。我们分别采用了三种不同的 EoS 重建方法，所得出的 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 和 \(R_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 几乎相同，其中 \(R_{\mathrm{TOV}}=11.90_{-0.60}^{+0.63}\) km 是最致密非转动中子星的半径。这一被精确评估的 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 表明，中子星物质的 EoS 仅是中等刚硬的，而第二代引力波探测器探测到的 \(\sim 2.5─3 M_{\odot}\) 致密天体最可能是最轻的黑洞。
AI.tldr: 本文利用中子星质量/半径测量与致密物质状态方程重建两种方法，结合脉冲星、GW170817及理论约束，首次以约3%精度推断非转动中子星最大引力质量 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}=2.25_{-0.07}^{+0.08} M_{\odot}\)，并指出 \(\sim2.5–3 M_{\odot}\) 的致密天体最可能是最轻的黑洞。
AI.motivation: 非转动中子星的最大引力质量 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 是致密天体的关键参数，但仅凭第一性原理只能得到宽松的约束。本文旨在通过结合质量分布与状态方程重建两种途径，对 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 进行精确推断。
AI.method: 融合两类方法推断 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\)：更新的中子星质量测量样本、GW170817的质量—潮汐形变数据、PSR J0030+0451与PSR J0740+6620的质量—半径数据，并加入手征有效理论与微扰量子色动力学（pQCD）分别在低、极高能量密度下的理论约束；分别采用三种不同的 EoS 重建方法进行交叉验证。
AI.result: 精确推断得到 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}=2.25_{-0.07}^{+0.08} M_{\odot}\)（68.3% 置信度）。窄置信区间来自 pQCD 约束对高 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 的抑制和质量函数对低 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 的排除。三种 EoS 重建方法所得 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 与 \(R_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 几乎一致，其中 \(R_{\mathrm{TOV}}=11.90_{-0.60}^{+0.63}\) km 为最致密非转动中子星的半径。
AI.conclusion: 所精确评估的 \(M_{\mathrm{TOV}}\) 表明中子星物质的 EoS 仅是中等刚硬的，且 \(\sim 2.5─3 M_{\odot}\) 的致密天体最可能是最轻的黑洞。该结论基于摘要中列出的数据与理论约束；对于与本论文主题以外的脉冲星、磁星或FRB等方面的转移性，根据摘要无法判断。

title: Magnetar field dynamics driven by chiral anomalies without magnetic helicity
summary: The chiral magnetic effect (CME), arising from the chiral anomaly and enabling a mutual conversion between magnetic topology and fermionic chirality, is a key mechanism in magnetar field evolution. In previous work, Dehman and Pons [Phys. Rev. Res. 7, 033231 (2025).PPRHAI2643-156410.1103/rhv5-nd4v] demonstrated that the CME can efficiently generate dipolar fields (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>B</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>dip</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>≳</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mn>14</mml:mn></mml:msup><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>G</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula>), consistent with magnetar timing measurements, provided that the initial magnetic field carries net helicity. However, whether neutron stars are born with magnetic helicity remains uncertain. In this work, we investigate the CME across a range of initial helicity configurations, including nonhelical initial conditions. We find that the CME efficiently generates magnetar-strength dipoles on timescales of decades, independently of the initial helicity content. The chiral instability is driven by localized helical structures that induce a residual chiral asymmetry and is primarily governed by the maximum chiral chemical potential, requiring <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msubsup><mml:mi>μ</mml:mi><mml:mn>5</mml:mn><mml:mi>max</mml:mi></mml:msubsup><mml:mo>≳</mml:mo><mml:mi>few</mml:mi><mml:mo>×</mml:mo><mml:msup><mml:mn>10</mml:mn><mml:mrow><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mn>11</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:msup><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mtext> </mml:mtext><mml:mi>MeV</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> for onset in the magnetar regime. Our results further show that these dipoles may either remain stable and subsequently evolve through standard Ohmic decay, or become unstable if they acquire sufficient helicity, in which case they decay through the chiral anomaly, transferring energy to less helical modes. This outcome depends sensitively on the initial helicity distribution. These findings extend the applicability of the CME to more realistic magnetic-field configurations and underscore the importance of the helicity distribution at birth; a quantity that remains poorly constrained in newborn neutron stars, yet is crucial for determining their magnetic evolution and the emergence of magnetars.

AI.abstract_translation: 手性磁效应（CME）源于手性反常，可实现磁拓扑与费米子手性之间的相互转换，是磁星磁场演化的一个关键机制。在先前的工作中，Dehman 与 Pons [Phys. Rev. Res. 7, 033231 (2025).PPRHAI2643-156410.1103/rhv5-nd4v] 证明，只要初始磁场携带净螺旋度，CME 就能高效地产生偶极场（B_dip ≳ 10^14 G），与磁星计时测量一致。然而，中子星诞生时是否携带磁螺旋度仍不确定。在本工作中，我们研究一系列初始螺旋度构型（包括非螺旋初始条件）下的 CME。我们发现，CME 能在数十年时间尺度上高效地产生磁星强度的偶极场，且独立于初始螺旋度含量。手性不稳定性由局域螺旋结构驱动，这些结构诱发残余手性不对称，并主要受最大手性化学势控制，其在磁星区域的出现需要 μ_5^max ≳ few × 10^{-11} MeV。我们的结果进一步表明，这些偶极场要么保持稳定并随后通过标准欧姆衰变演化，要么在获得足够螺旋度时变得不稳定，此时它们会通过手性反常衰变，将能量转移到螺旋度较弱的模式。这一结果敏感地依赖于初始螺旋度分布。这些发现将 CME 的适用性扩展到更真实的磁场构型，并强调了诞生时螺旋度分布的重要性；这一量在新诞生的中子星中仍缺乏约束，却又对其磁场演化和磁星的出现至关重要。
AI.tldr: 该工作研究了手性磁效应（CME）在中子星磁场演化中的作用，发现即使在没有初始磁螺旋度的情况下，CME 也能在数十年时间尺度上高效产生磁星强度的偶极场（B_dip ≳ 10^14 G），其出现主要受最大手性化学势 μ_5^max ≳ few × 10^{-11} MeV 控制。
AI.motivation: 先前工作表明 CME 需初始磁场携带净螺旋度方能产生与磁星计时测量一致的偶极场，但中子星诞生时是否携带磁螺旋度仍不确定。本文旨在考察 CME 在一系列初始螺旋度构型（包括非螺旋初始条件）下的行为，扩展其适用性至更真实的磁场构型，并强调出生时螺旋度分布这一缺乏约束的关键量。
AI.method: 摘要未说明具体观测方法；本研究为理论建模工作，通过考察一系列初始螺旋度构型（含非螺旋初始条件）下的手性磁效应（CME）演化，分析局域螺旋结构诱导的残余手性不对称，并评估最大手性化学势（μ_5^max）对偶极场出现的影响及其后续演化路径。
AI.result: CME 可在数十年时间尺度上高效产生磁星强度的偶极场（B_dip ≳ 10^14 G），独立于初始螺旋度含量。手性不稳定性由局域螺旋结构驱动，主要受最大手性化学势控制，需 μ_5^max ≳ few × 10^{-11} MeV 方在磁星区域出现。所得偶极场可保持稳定并随后经标准欧姆衰变演化，或在获得足够螺旋度时失稳，经手性反常衰变将能量转移到螺旋度较弱的模式，其结果敏感依赖初始螺旋度分布。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为这些发现将 CME 的适用性扩展到更真实的磁场构型，并强调中子星诞生时螺旋度分布的重要性；该分布在新诞生的中子星中仍缺乏约束，却对其磁场演化和磁星的出现至关重要。摘要未明确讨论与脉冲星、磁星计时或 FRB 的观测联系，仅以磁星计时测量作为先前结果的一致性参照。

title: Neutron star with dark matter using vector portal
summary: Compact astrophysical objects, such as neutron stars, can provide a unique environment where the interplay between strongly interacting nuclear matter and dark matter (DM) can yield possible observable signatures. We investigate here the impact of fermionic DM interacting with nucleons via a vector mediator (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>Z</mml:mi><mml:mo>'</mml:mo></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula>) portal inside neutron stars using the relativistic mean-field framework. Unlike scalar portal DM models, which primarily modify the effective nucleon mass through scalar interactions, vector mediators (<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>Z</mml:mi><mml:mo>'</mml:mo></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula>) introduce additional repulsive interactions that directly affect the baryonic chemical potential and the pressure of dense matter. We show that the precise measurements of neutron-star properties, including the mass-radius relation and tidal deformability from gravitational wave observations and x-ray and radio observations of pulsars, can shed light on properties of DM. We study the gross structural properties of a neutron star using the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff equations, employing an equation of state (EOS) for neutron-star matter in the presence of vector portal-assisted DM. The resulting stellar configurations, consistent with observational bounds from gravitational wave observations (GW170817) in LIGO/Virgo and x-ray observations of pulsar PSR <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>J</mml:mi><mml:mn>0030</mml:mn><mml:mo>+</mml:mo><mml:mn>0451</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula> in NICER, are shown to constrain the vector portal DM parameters. It is observed that, while large portal mass can soften the EOS of the DM-admixed neutron-star matter, the light portal mass can make the EOS stiffer at large densities, resulting in distinct mass-radius relation and the tidal deformability between the two scenarios. The vector portal DM scenario, with DM interaction with quarks via the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>Z</mml:mi><mml:mo>'</mml:mo></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula> vector boson, can establish a direct connection to terrestrial searches, including direct and indirect detection and collider searches for the <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msup><mml:mi>Z</mml:mi><mml:mo>'</mml:mo></mml:msup></mml:math></inline-formula> boson. Taken together, these constitute a comprehensive framework that bridges neutron-star astrophysics with particle physics, enabling a multimessenger exploration of DM properties.

AI.abstract_translation: 致密天体，如中子星，可以提供独特的物理环境，使强相互作用的核物质与暗物质（DM）之间的相互作用可能产生可观测的迹象。我们在此研究中子星内部通过矢量中介体（$Z'$）规范玻色子与核子相互作用的费米子暗物质的影响，使用相对论平均场框架。与主要通过标量相互作用改变有效核子质量的标量门户暗物质模型不同，矢量中介体（$Z'$）引入了额外的排斥性相互作用，直接影响重子化学势和致密物质的压强。我们表明，对中子星性质的精确测量，包括来自引力波观测以及脉冲星的X射线和射电观测的质量-半径关系和潮汐形变率，可以为暗物质的性质提供信息。我们使用Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff方程研究中子星的总体结构性质，采用了在矢量门户辅助暗物质存在下的中子星物质状态方程（EOS）。所得恒星构型与来自LIGO/Virgo中引力波观测（GW170817）以及NICER中脉冲星PSR J0030+0451的X射线观测的观测约束一致，显示可以约束矢量门户暗物质参数。我们观察到，虽然较大的门户质量可以使含暗物质的中子星物质的EOS变软，但较轻的门户质量可以在大密度下使EOS变得更硬，导致两种情形之间质量-半径关系和潮汐形变率存在明显差异。矢量门户暗物质情形中，暗物质通过$Z'$矢量玻色子与夸克相互作用，可以建立与地面搜索的直接联系，包括对$Z'$玻色子的直接探测、间接探测以及对撞机搜索。综合来看，这些构成了一个连接中子星天体物理学与粒子物理学的综合框架，使得对暗物质性质的多信使探索成为可能。
AI.tldr: 该论文在相对论平均场框架下研究中子星内通过矢量门户（$Z'$玻色子）与核子相互作用的费米子暗物质，发现大门户质量可使EOS变软，而轻门户质量使EOS在大密度下变硬，导致两种质量-半径关系和潮汐形变率情形明显不同，并可用GW170817和NICER对PSR J0030+0451的观测来约束矢量门户暗物质参数。
AI.motivation: 研究中子星中超相对论致密物质与暗物质相互作用的可能可观测迹象，尤其是矢量门户费米子暗物质经$Z'$玻色子对核子产生的排斥性相互作用如何改变致密物质性质，并利用观测约束反推暗物质性质。
AI.method: 采用相对论平均场框架，加入通过矢量中介体（$Z'$）与核子相互作用的费米子暗物质，使用Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff方程研究中子星的总体结构性质，采用含矢量门户辅助暗物质的中子星物质状态方程（EOS），并将所得构型与引力波（LIGO/Virgo，GW170817）和X射线观测（NICER的PSR J0030+0451）的观测约束进行比较。
AI.result: 显示所得恒星构型与GW170817及NICER对PSR J0030+0451的观测约束一致，可约束矢量门户暗物质参数。观察到较大门户质量可使含暗物质的中子星物质EOS变软，而轻门户质量可使EOS在大密度下更硬，两者导致明显不同的质量-半径关系和潮汐形变率。
AI.conclusion: 作者结论是矢量门户暗物质经$Z'$矢量玻色子与夸克相互作用，可建立与地面直接探测、间接探测和对撞机搜索的直接联系，构成连接中子星天体物理与粒子物理、实现暗物质性质多信使探索的综合框架。该摘要未直接涉及脉冲星、磁星或FRB的相关物理解释，因此根据摘要无法判断此类转移适用性。

title: Indication for Decreasing Dispersion Measure in the Population of Repeating Fast Radio Bursts and Connection to Young Supernova Remnant Expansion
summary: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration, highly energetic radio transients of uncertain origin. Repeating FRBs provide an excellent population for investigating their nature, particularly through studies of parameter evolution. Out of the 63 repeaters monitored by CHIME, we select the 19 sources with more than 10 detected bursts and examine their long-term dispersion measure (DM) evolution. Seven sources show statistically significant DM evolution and are classified as the golden sample. Of these, five exhibit a decreasing DM trend and two show an increasing trend. We then perform a binomial test under the null hypothesis that decreasing and increasing DM variation trends have equal probabilities. The current combined sample, including our golden sample and additional repeaters with reported DM change rate from the literature, gives a p-value of 0.033, supporting that decreasing DM trends are more common in the repeating FRB population. This statistical result is consistent with scenarios in that the local electron density around repeaters generally decreases with time, for example, due to expansion of a young supernova remnant (SNR). Finally, within the SNR expansion model, we provide an illustrative estimate of the SNR contributions to the DM for different ejecta masses.

AI.abstract_translation: 快速射电暴（FRB）是持续时间为毫秒量级、能量极高、起源尚不明确的射电瞬变源。重复暴FRB提供了一个研究其本质的优秀样本，尤其是通过参数演化的研究。在CHIME监测到的63个重复暴中，我们选取了拥有超过10次已探测暴发的19个源，并检验它们长期的色散量（DM）演化。其中7个源展现出统计显著的DM演化，被归类为"黄金样本"。在这些源中，5个呈现下降的DM趋势，2个呈现上升趋势。随后我们在下降与上升DM变化趋势概率相等的零假设下进行了二项检验。当前合并样本（包含我们的黄金样本以及文献中报道了DM变化率的其他重复暴）给出的p值为0.033，支持在重复暴FRB群体中下降的DM趋势更为常见。这一统计结果与重复暴周围局部电子密度随时间大致下降的情景一致，例如源于年轻超新星遗迹（SNR）的膨胀。最后，在SNR膨胀模型内，我们针对不同的抛射物质量提供了SNR对DM贡献的说明性估计。
AI.tldr: 对CHIME监测的重复FRB样本的长期DM演化进行统计，发现下降的DM趋势比上升趋势更常见（p=0.033），这与年轻超新星遗迹膨胀导致重复暴周围电子密度下降的情景一致。
AI.motivation: 重复暴FRB是研究FRB本质的重要群体，尤其可通过参数（如DM）演化进行研究。本研究的科学问题是重复暴FRB群体中DM随时间变化的方向是否有系统偏向，以及这种趋势是否能为起源环境提供线索。
AI.method: 从CHIME监测的63个重复暴中选取拥有超过10次已探测暴发的19个源，检验其长期DM演化；选出7个统计显著的源作为黄金样本，并对其DM趋势进行二项检验（零假设为升降趋势等概率）；结合文献中报道的DM变化率的其他重复暴构成合并样本，并在SNR膨胀模型内给出不同抛射物质量的DM贡献估计。
AI.result: 7个源显示统计显著的DM演化（黄金样本），其中5个呈现下降趋势、2个呈现上升趋势。合并文献样本后的二项检验给出p值为0.033，支持重复暴FRB群体中下降DM趋势更为常见。该统计结果与重复暴周围局部电子密度随时间下降（如年轻SNR膨胀）的情景一致。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为下降DM趋势在重复暴FRB群体中更普遍，统计上支持重复暴周围局部电子密度随时间大致下降，可能源于年轻超新星遗迹的膨胀。文中仅提供SNR对DM贡献的说明性估计。根据摘要无法判断这一情景是否与磁星或FRB本质的其他模型存在直接因果联系。

title: Statistical Inference of Fast Radio Burst Environments Using Galaxy Number Density
summary: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are bright, millisecond-duration radio transients of unknown origin. They are categorized as repeaters and non-repeaters, possibly indicating distinct progenitor types. However, validating this distinction is difficult because of the limited number of localized FRBs. Large-scale galactic environments can provide insight into the nature of the host galaxies of FRB and their progenitors. High-number-density regions are typically associated with old galaxies, whereas low-number-density regions are linked to young star-forming or less massive quiescent galaxies. In this study, we use galaxy number density to statistically assess the environments of 19 repeaters and 253 non-repeaters from CHIME Catalog 1, using galaxies from the WISE × PS1 catalog. A Kolmogorov─Smirnov (KS) test showed no significant difference between the two populations (p<SUB>KS</SUB> = 0.673). This result indicates that the statistical significance of the difference could depend on small-number statistics, highlighting the necessity of future FRB samples. Intriguingly, a comparison of FRBs with random galaxy fields suggests that FRBs may preferentially occur in underdense galactic environments with a median p-value (p<SUB>KS</SUB>) = 2.84 × 10<SUP>−2</SUP> compared to random galaxy apertures.
journal: Publications of the Astronomical Society of the Pacific

AI.abstract_translation: 快速射电暴（FRB）是起源未知的明亮、毫秒级射电瞬变源。它们被分为重复暴和非重复暴，这可能表明存在不同的前身星类型。然而，由于已被定位的FRB数量有限，验证这一区分十分困难。大规模星系环境可以为洞察FRB宿主星系的本质及其前身星提供信息。高数密度区域通常与老年星系相关，而低数密度区域则与年轻恒星形成星系或质量较小的宁静星系相关。在本研究中，我们利用星系数密度对来自CHIME目录1的19个重复暴和253个非重复暴的环境进行统计评估，使用了来自WISE × PS1目录的星系。Kolmogorov─Smirnov（KS）检验显示两个群体之间没有显著差异（p<SUB>KS</SUB> = 0.673）。这一结果表明，差异的统计显著性可能取决于小样本统计，凸显了未来FRB样本的必要性。有趣的是，与随机星系场相比，FRB可能倾向于发生在欠密的星系环境中，与随机星系孔径相比，其p值中位数（p<SUB>KS</SUB>）= 2.84 × 10<SUP>−2</SUP>。

AI.conclusion: 作者指出，两个FRB群体环境差异的统计显著性可能受小样本统计影响，凸显了未来更大FRB样本的必要性。FRB可能倾向于出现在欠密星系环境的发现暗示其与前身星/宿主星系性质存在潜在联系；但该物理联系及其对磁星或FRB机制的转移意义，根据摘要无法判断。

title: Fingerprints of individual supermassive black hole binaries in pulsar timing arrays
summary: With evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background now established by pulsar timing arrays, the search focuses on identifying individual supermassive black hole binaries. We show that these binaries produce a distinct spatial correlation pattern across the array, acting as a deterministic analog to the stochastic Hellings and Downs curve. We derive a closed analytic expression for this single-source overlap reduction function, <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>ϒ</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>a</mml:mi><mml:mi>b</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>, factorizing the signal into a source-dependent amplitude and a purely geometric fingerprint. Using simulated datasets, we demonstrate that this fingerprint breaks the degeneracy between an individual binary and a stochastic background. Including these cross-correlations yields Bayes factors of 1611 favoring the continuous-wave model over a Hellings and Downs correlated background model and 159 favoring the continuous-wave model over an uncorrelated red-noise model. Furthermore, these new cross-correlations improve sky localization by a factor of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mn>11</mml:mn><mml:mi>x</mml:mi></mml:math></inline-formula> over an uncorrelated search. Finally, while coherent matched filtering offers higher theoretical sensitivity, we argue that a cross-correlation-based search for individual binaries provides a robust alternative that hedges against the possibility of overfitting to noise fluctuations by focusing on the evidence for the correlations. Indeed, the geometric fingerprints we present here show that spatial correlations can also be used to identify the first nanohertz gravitational-wave sources.

AI.abstract_translation: 随着脉冲星计时阵列现已确立毫赫兹引力波背景存在的证据，搜索的重点转向识别单个超大质量黑洞双星。我们表明，这些双星会在整个阵列中产生一种独特的空间相关性模式，作为随机Hellings and Downs曲线的确定性模拟。我们推导出这一单源重叠约化函数的闭式解析表达式，<inline-formula><mml:math><mml:msub><mml:mi>ϒ</mml:mi><mml:mrow><mml:mi>a</mml:mi><mml:mi>b</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:math></inline-formula>，将该信号分解为依赖源振幅与纯几何指纹。利用模拟数据集，我们证明该指纹打破了单个双星与随机背景之间的简并。包含这些互相关项后，所得贝叶斯因子为1611，支持连续波模型优于Hellings and Downs相关背景模型，以及159，支持连续波模型优于不相关红噪声模型。此外，这些新的互相关项将天区定位能力提高了11x，优于不相关搜索。最后，虽然相干匹配滤波能提供更高的理论灵敏度，但我们主张基于互相关项的单个双星搜索是一种稳健的替代方案，它通过聚焦于相关性的证据，对冲了将噪声涨落过度拟合的可能性。事实上，我们这里呈现的几何指纹表明，空间相关性也可用于识别第一批毫赫兹引力波源。

AI.motivation: 毫赫兹引力波背景的证据现已确立，识别单个超大质量黑洞双星成为下一步搜索焦点。作者旨在利用阵列特有的空间相关模式来区分单个双星与随机背景，以识别第一批毫赫兹引力波源。

title: Multimodality in the Search for New Physics in Pulsar Timing Data and the Case of Kination-amplified Gravitational-wave Background from Inflation
summary: We investigate the kination-amplified inflationary gravitational-wave background (GWB) interpretation of the signal recently reported by various pulsar timing array (PTA) experiments. Kination is a post-inflationary phase in the expansion history dominated by the kinetic energy of some scalar field, characterized by a stiff equation of state w = 1. Within the inflationary GWB model, we identify two modes that can fit the current data sets (NANOGrav and EPTA) with equal likelihood: the kination-amplification (KA) mode and the ordinary, no-kination-amplification (no-KA) mode. The multimodality of the likelihood motivates a Bayesian analysis with nested sampling. We analyze the free spectra of current PTA data and mock free spectra constructed with higher signal-to-noise ratios using nested sampling. The analysis of the mock spectrum designed to be consistent with the best fit to the NANOGrav 15 yr (NG15) data successfully reveals the expected bimodal posterior for the first time while excluding the reheating mode that appears in the fit to the current NG15 data, making a case for our correct and comprehensive treatment of potential multimodal posteriors arising from future PTA data sets. The resultant Bayes factor is <inline-formula> <mml:math><mml:mi>B</mml:mi><mml:mo>≡</mml:mo><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>Z</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>no</mml:mi><mml:mo>-</mml:mo><mml:mi>KA</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>/</mml:mo><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>Z</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>KA</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>2.9</mml:mn><mml:mo>±</mml:mo><mml:mn>1.9</mml:mn></mml:math> </inline-formula>, indicating comparable statistical significance between the two modes. Given the theoretical model-building challenges of producing highly blue-tilted primordial tensor spectra, the KA mode has the advantage of requiring less blue primordial spectra, compared with the no-KA mode. The synergy between future cosmic microwave background polarization, pulsar timing, and laser interferometer measurements of gravitational waves will help resolve the ambiguity implied by the multimodal posterior in PTA-only searches.

AI.abstract_translation: 我们研究动缩放大（kination-amplified）的暴胀引力波背景（GWB）对近期各脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）实验所报告信号的解释。动缩是膨胀历史中由某个标量场的动能主导的后暴胀阶段，其特征是刚性状态方程 w = 1。在暴胀GWB模型内，我们识别出两个能以相同似然拟合当前数据集（NANOGrav和EPTA）的模式：动缩放大（KA）模式和普通的、无动缩放大（no-KA）模式。似然的多模态性促使采用嵌套采样进行贝叶斯分析。我们利用嵌套采样分析当前PTA数据的自由谱以及以更高信噪比构造的模拟自由谱。针对旨在与NANOGrav 15年（NG15）数据最佳拟合一致的模拟谱的分析，首次成功揭示了预期的双峰后验，同时排除了对当前NG15数据拟合中出现的再加热模式，这为我们需要正确且全面地处理未来PTA数据集可能产生的多模态后验提供了依据。所得贝叶斯因子为 B≡Z_{no-KA}/Z_{KA}=2.9±1.9，表明两个模式之间具有相当的统计显著性。鉴于产生高度蓝倾斜的原初张量谱在理论模型构建上的困难，与no-KA模式相比，KA模式的优势在于所需的原初谱蓝倾斜程度较低。未来宇宙微波背景极化、脉冲星计时和激光干涉仪引力波测量之间的协同将有助于消解仅凭PTA搜索中多模态后验所隐含的歧义。
AI.tldr: 本文研究动缩放大的暴胀引力波背景对NANOGrav与EPTA等PTA实验所报告信号的解释，识别出KA与no-KA两个似然相同的模式；嵌套采样分析NG15模拟自由谱首次成功揭示预期双峰后验并排除再加热模式，所得贝叶斯因子B=2.9±1.9，表明两模式统计显著性相当。
AI.motivation: 本文针对近期各PTA实验所报告信号的动缩放大暴胀GWB解释展开研究。研究动机是揭示该模型似然的多模态性：当前数据（NANOGrav与EPTA）可由KA和no-KA两种模式以相同似然拟合，因此需要开展能正确处理多模态后验的贝叶斯分析，以评估两种解释的统计显著性和对原初张量谱倾斜度的要求。
AI.method: 采用嵌套采样进行贝叶斯多模态分析。分析对象包括当前PTA数据（NANOGrav和EPTA）的自由谱，以及以更高信噪比构造的模拟自由谱，其中模拟谱被设计为与NANOGrav 15年（NG15）数据的最佳拟合一致。计算贝叶斯因子 B≡Z_{no-KA}/Z_{KA}。
AI.result: 在暴胀GWB模型内识别出两个以相同似然拟合当前数据集的模式：KA模式和no-KA模式。对与NG15最佳拟合一致的模拟自由谱的分析首次成功揭示预期的双峰后验，并排除了对当前NG15数据拟合中出现的再加热模式。所得贝叶斯因子B≡Z_{no-KA}/Z_{KA}=2.9±1.9，表明两个模式在统计显著性上相当。相对于no-KA模式，KA模式所需原初谱的蓝倾斜程度较低。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为KA模式与no-KA模式对当前PTA数据具有相当的统计显著性，且KA模式因所需原初张量谱蓝倾斜度较低而在模型构建上更具优势。多模态后验所隐含的歧义在仅凭PTA搜索中无法消解；作者指出未来CMB极化、脉冲星计时和激光干涉仪引力波测量的协同将有助于解决这一歧义。根据摘要无法判断该方法与磁星或FRB的关联。

title: Cosmic Variance in Anisotropy Searches at Pulsar Timing Arrays
summary: Recent pulsar timing array (PTA) analyses show evidence for a gravitational wave background (GWB) with angular correlations consistent with the Hellings-Downs curve. Anisotropies are a key discriminator of the origin of this GWB, as they are expected to be at 1%─20% for astrophysical sources, but suppressed for cosmological GWBs. However, contrary to gravitational wave detectors at higher frequencies, PTAs only take a few independent measurements of a GWB and consequently are highly sensitive to cosmic variance, which induces apparent anisotropies in individual realizations of an isotropic GWB. We demonstrate explicitly that statistical inference nevertheless remains robust, i.e., measurements are consistent with the underlying assumption of isotropy. This confirms that searches for anisotropies will be able to robustly discriminate astrophysical from cosmological GWBs. To this end, we demonstrate that the maximum multipole constrained by a PTA dataset scales linearly with the number of pulsars <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mo>ℓ</mml:mo></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>max</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub><mml:mo>∼</mml:mo><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>N</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>p</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:mrow></mml:math></inline-formula>.

AI.abstract_translation: 最近的脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）分析显示出引力波背景（GWB）的证据，其角相关性与Hellings-Downs曲线一致。各向异性是甄别该GWB起源的关键判别量，因为对于天体物理源，各向异性预计在1%—20%，而对于宇宙学GWB则被抑制。然而，与更高频率的引力波探测器相反，PTA仅对GWB进行少数几次独立测量，因此对宇宙方差高度敏感，宇宙方差会在各向同性GWB的单个实现中诱导出表现上的各向异性。我们明确地证明，统计推断仍然保持稳健，即测量结果与潜在的各向同性假设一致。这证实对各向异性的搜索将能够稳健地区分天体物理源与宇宙学GWB。为此，我们证明PTA数据集中受约束的最大多极阶数与脉冲星数目呈线性关系：ℓ_max ∼ N_p。
AI.tldr: 该论文证明，尽管脉冲星计时阵列对宇宙方差高度敏感，会在各向同性GWB的单个实现中诱导表现上的各向异性，但统计推断仍保持稳健，即测量与各向同性假设一致。作者还证明PTA数据集受约束的最大多极阶数与脉冲星数目呈线性关系（ℓ_max ∼ N_p）。
AI.motivation: 脉冲星计时阵列分析显示GWB的角相关符合Hellings-Downs曲线。各向异性是区分天体物理源与宇宙学GWB起源的关键，但PTA仅做少数独立测量，对宇宙方差高度敏感，可能在单个各向同性GWB实现中诱导表现上的各向异性，因此需要检验统计推断是否仍稳健。
AI.method: 摘要未说明具体观测数据、望远镜、观测频率或时间跨度。论文采用统计推断方法，研究PTA对各向同性GWB单个实现中的宇宙方差效应，并分析最大可约束多极阶数与脉冲星数目的关系。具体分析手段（如计时、角相关测量等）摘要未说明。

title: Leave-one-out comparison of ultralight dark matter and environmental models for pulsar-timing-array data
summary: Previous work showed that ultralight-dark-matter solitons can provide dynamical friction for supermassive black-hole binaries, suppressing low-frequency power in the pulsar-timing-array gravitational-wave background and constraining the particle mass and effective ultralight-dark-matter fraction. Here we extend that analysis by comparing the predictive performance of four models: simplified and realistic ultralight-dark-matter implementations, a phenomenological environmental-hardening model, and a gravitational-wave-only model. We use Bayesian leave-one-out cross-validation on the five lowest pulsar-timing-array frequency bins. The phenomenological model gives the largest expected log predictive density, but its advantage over the other models is not large compared with the estimated standard errors. The current data therefore do not decisively prefer one model overall. The clearest pairwise result is within the ultralight-dark-matter framework: The simplified model outperforms the realistic implementation in all five frequency bins. Current pulsar-timing-array data are therefore compatible with ultralight-dark-matter-induced low-frequency suppression, but do not yet distinguish ultralight-dark-matter significantly from more generic environmental descriptions of supermassive-black-hole-binary evolution.

AI.abstract_translation: 此前的工作表明，超轻暗物质孤子可以为超大质量黑洞双星提供动力学摩擦，抑制脉冲星计时阵列引力波背景中的低频功率，并约束粒子质量和有效超轻暗物质占比。在此我们扩展该分析，比较四个模型的预测性能：简化的和现实的超轻暗物质实现、一个唯象的环境致密化模型，以及一个仅含引力波的模型。我们对脉冲星计时阵列最低的五个频率频段使用贝叶斯留一法交叉验证。唯象模型给出的期望对数预测密度最大，但其相对于其他模型的优势与估计标准差相比并不大。因此当前数据并未决定性地偏好某一个模型。最清晰的两两比较结果出现在超轻暗物质框架内部：简化模型在所有五个频率频段中均优于现实实现。因此，当前的脉冲星计时阵列数据与超轻暗物质引起的低频抑制相容，但尚不能将超轻暗物质与更一般的超大质量黑洞双星演化环境描述显著区分开来。

AI.motivation: 此前工作表明超轻暗物质孤子可为超大质量黑洞双星提供动力学摩擦，抑制脉冲星计时阵列引力波背景低频功率并约束粒子质量。本文在此基础上扩展，通过比较四个候选模型的预测性能，检验超轻暗物质解释与更一般的环境模型之间的区分能力。
AI.method: 摘要说明：采用贝叶斯留一法交叉验证，比较四种模型（简化与现实的超轻暗物质实现、唯象的环境致密化模型、仅引力波模型）的预测性能，针对脉冲星计时阵列最低的五个频率频段进行分析。
AI.result: 唯象环境致密化模型给出最大的期望对数预测密度，但其优势相对于估计标准差并不大；当前数据未决定性偏好某一模型。最清晰的两两结果为：在超轻暗物质框架内，简化模型在所有五个频率频段均优于现实实现。

title: The Circumgalactic Medium with Local Universe Fast Radio Bursts: Evidence of Strong Active Galactic Nucleus Feedback in a Massive Elliptical Galaxy
summary: Modern cosmology and galaxy formation rely on an understanding of how cosmic baryons are distributed, a significant portion of which exists in the diffuse gas confined to halos. Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are a promising probe of the Universe's ionized gas. At low redshift, the contribution to the dispersion measure (DM) from the intergalactic medium (IGM) and intervening halos is subdominant, allowing us to study the circumgalactic medium (CGM) of the host galaxies, if the host interstellar medium (ISM) can be sufficiently suppressed. We select a sample of five local Universe FRBs with host halos spanning a wide range in mass (~10<SUP>11-13</SUP> M<SUB>⊙</SUB>), and with indicators that host ISM DM is negligible. We use these FRBs to constrain the CGM in each halo by comparing to simulations and measuring the CGM mass assuming a range of spherical gas profiles. We find that one of our sources, the only massive elliptical host galaxy, strongly disfavors low feedback scenarios in simulations, and has been evacuated of its baryons (~ 10% of the cosmological average <inline-formula> <mml:math><mml:mfrac><mml:mrow><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>Ω</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>b</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:msub><mml:mrow><mml:mi>Ω</mml:mi></mml:mrow><mml:mrow><mml:mi>m</mml:mi></mml:mrow></mml:msub></mml:mrow></mml:mfrac></mml:math> </inline-formula> within R<SUB>vir</SUB>). This galaxy shows evidence of a past episode of active galactic nucleus (AGN) activity, consistent with the picture of strong AGN feedback in galaxy group-scale halos. The gas mass measurements for the other sources tentatively support more baryon retention in L<SUB>*</SUB> galaxies compared to group-scale halos. Finally, we demonstrate that a large sample of local Universe FRBs will enable precision measurements of halo gas.

AI.abstract_translation: 现代宇宙学与星系形成依赖于对宇宙重子分布的理解，而其中相当一部分重子存在于被约束在暗物质晕中的弥散气体中。快速射电暴（FRB）是探测宇宙电离气体的有前景的探针。在低红移下，来自星系际介质（IGM）和其间暗物质晕对色散量（DM）的贡献是次主导的，这使得如果寄主星系际介质（ISM）的贡献能被充分抑制，我们就能够研究寄主星系的星系周介质（CGM）。我们选取了五个本地宇宙FRB的样本，其寄主暗物质晕的質量范围很广（约10^11-13 M_⊙），并且有指标表明寄主ISM的DM可忽略不计。我们利用这些FRB，通过与模拟比较并假定一系列球形气体分布来测量各暗物质晕中的CGM质量，从而约束每个暗物质晕中的CGM。我们发现我们的一个源，也就是唯一的大质量椭圆寄主星系，在模拟中强烈不支持低反馈情景，并且其重子已被排空（在R_vir内约为宇宙学平均值Ω_b/Ω_m的10%）。这个星系显示出过去曾有过活动星系核（AGN）活动的证据，这与星系群尺度暗物质晕中强AGN反馈的图像一致。其他源的气体质量测量初步支持L_*星系比群尺度暗物质晕保留更多重子。最后，我们证明大量的本地宇宙FRB样本将能够实现晕气体的高精度测量。
AI.tldr: 利用五个本地宇宙FRB约束寄主暗物质晕中的CGM质量，发现唯一的大质量椭圆星系强烈不支持低反馈模拟，其重子已被排空（R_vir内约Ω_b/Ω_m宇宙平均值的10%），与该星系过去的AGN活动的强反馈图像一致。
AI.motivation: 研究旨在理解宇宙重子的分布，其中相当一部分存在于约束在暗物质晕中的弥散气体中。由于本地宇宙FRB的DM中对IGM和其间晕的贡献为次主导，若寄主ISM贡献可忽略，便可用于研究寄主星系CGM，从而填补用FRB约束本地晕气体分布的空白。
AI.method: 选取五个本地宇宙FRB样本，其寄主暗物质晕質量范围约10^11-13 M_⊙，且指标表明寄主ISM的DM可忽略不计。通过将这些FRB的测量与模拟进行比较，并假定一系列球形气体分布来测量各暗物质晕中的CGM质量，从而约束每个晕中的CGM。
AI.result: 唯一的大质量椭圆寄主星系强烈不支持模拟中的低反馈情景，且已被排空重子（在R_vir内约Ω_b/Ω_m宇宙平均值的10%）。该星系显示过去有AGN活动证据。其他源的气体质量测量初步支持L_*星系比群尺度暗物质晕保留更多重子。此外，大量本地宇宙FRB样本将能实现晕气体的高精度测量。
AI.conclusion: 作者指出该大质量椭圆星系的结果与星系群尺度暗物质晕中强AGN反馈的图像一致，且气体质量测量初步支持L_*星系比群尺度暗物质晕保留更多重子，并表明大量本地FRB样本将使晕气体的精密测量成为可能。根据摘要无法判断。

title: X-ray and radio view of the Be/X-ray binary pulsar 1A 1118-61 during the 2026 giant outburst
summary: We present a detailed X-ray and radio study of the Be/X-ray binary pulsar 1A 1118--61 during its 2026 giant outburst using NuSTAR, Swift/XRT, and MeerKAT observations. Timing analysis reveals coherent pulsations with spin periods of <inline-formula><tex-math>$\sim$</tex-math></inline-formula>408.77 and <inline-formula><tex-math>$\sim$</tex-math></inline-formula>408.30 s at luminosities of <inline-formula><tex-math>$\sim$</tex-math></inline-formula>2.44 <inline-formula><tex-math>$\times$</tex-math></inline-formula> 10<inline-formula><tex-math>$^{37}$</tex-math></inline-formula> erg s<inline-formula><tex-math>$^{-1}$</tex-math></inline-formula> and <inline-formula><tex-math>$\sim$</tex-math></inline-formula>9.7 <inline-formula><tex-math>$\times$</tex-math></inline-formula> 10<inline-formula><tex-math>$^{35}$</tex-math></inline-formula> erg s<inline-formula><tex-math>$^{-1}$</tex-math></inline-formula>, respectively. The pulse profiles show a clear dependence on both energy and luminosity. At higher luminosity, the profile is smooth and single-peaked, whereas at lower luminosity, an absorption-like feature appears, indicating changes in the accretion geometry. A quasi-periodic oscillation (QPO) at 0.106 Hz is detected during the NuSTAR observation at higher luminosity. Broadband spectral analysis using NuSTAR data reveals a cyclotron resonance scattering feature (CRSF) at <inline-formula><tex-math>$\sim$</tex-math></inline-formula>53.9 keV during the high-luminosity observation, corresponding to a neutron star magnetic field strength of <inline-formula><tex-math>$\sim$</tex-math></inline-formula>6.0 <inline-formula><tex-math>$\times$</tex-math></inline-formula> 10<inline-formula><tex-math>$^{12}$</tex-math></inline-formula> G. However, no CRSF is detected in the spectrum at the lower luminosity. An iron K<inline-formula><tex-math>$\alpha$</tex-math></inline-formula> line at 6.4 keV is evident in both NuSTAR observations, while an additional weak higher-energy iron emission feature at <inline-formula><tex-math>$\sim$</tex-math></inline-formula>6.9 keV is detected in the high-luminosity NuSTAR observation. The Swift/XRT spectra in the 1--10 keV energy range are well described using an absorbed power law and a blackbody component. Radio observation with MeerKAT during the decay phase of the X-ray outburst results in a non-detection, providing a stringent upper limit on the radio luminosity. This indicates weak or absent radio emission from 1A 1118--61 at the time of observation.
journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

AI.abstract_translation: 我们利用NuSTAR、Swift/XRT和MeerKAT的观测，对该Be/X射线双星脉冲星1A 1118–61在2026年巨暴发期间进行了详细的X射线和射电研究。计时分析揭示了相干脉冲，自转周期在光度分别为$\sim$2.44 $\times$ 10$^{37}$ erg s$^{-1}$和$\sim$9.7 $\times$ 10$^{35}$ erg s$^{-1}$时分别为$\sim$408.77和$\sim$408.30 s。脉冲轮廓明显依赖于能量和光度。在较高光度下，轮廓平滑且呈单峰；而在较低光度下，出现一个类似吸收的特征，表明吸积几何发生了变化。在较高光度下的NuSTAR观测期间，检测到0.106 Hz的准周期振荡（QPO）。利用NuSTAR数据进行的宽带能谱分析在较高光度观测期间揭示出位于$\sim$53.9 keV的回旋共振散射特征（CRSF），对应中子星磁场强度约为$\sim$6.0 $\times$ 10$^{12}$ G。然而，在较低光度下未检测到CRSF能谱特征。在两次NuSTAR观测中均明显存在6.4 keV的铁K$\alpha$线，而在较高光度的NuSTAR观测中检测到一个位于$\sim$6.9 keV的额外较弱的高能铁发射特征。1–10 keV能量范围内的Swift/XRT能谱可以用吸收幂律和黑体成分很好地描述。MeerKAT在X射线暴发衰减阶段进行的射电观测结果为未检测到，为射电光度提供了严格的限制上限。这表明1A 1118–61在观测时刻的射电发射很弱或不存在。
AI.tldr: 利用NuSTAR、Swift/XRT和MeerKAT观测，对Be/X射线双星脉冲星1A 1118–61在2026年巨暴发期间的研究表明：其自转周期约为408 s，脉冲轮廓依赖能量和光度，在高光度下检测到0.106 Hz QPO及约53.9 keV的CRSF，而射电观测为未检测到，表明射电发射很弱或不存在。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在利用2026年巨暴发的独特机会，通过多波段X射线和射电观测，详细表征Be/X射线双星脉冲星1A 1118–61在巨暴发期间的脉冲计时、脉冲轮廓演化、能谱特征及射电发射，以理解其吸积几何和磁场特性。
AI.method: 使用NuSTAR、Swift/XRT和MeerKAT的观测数据。采用计时分析探测相干脉冲并测量自转周期；在两种光度条件下分析脉冲轮廓；利用NuSTAR数据进行宽带能谱分析以探测QPO、CRSF和铁线；用吸收幂律加黑体模型拟合Swift/XRT在1–10 keV的能谱；并用MeerKAT在X射线暴发衰减阶段进行射电探测观测。
AI.result: 在光度$\sim$2.44 $\times$ 10$^{37}$和$\sim$9.7 $\times$ 10$^{35}$ erg s$^{-1}$下探测到自转周期分别约为408.77和408.30 s的相干脉冲。高光度下轮廓平滑且单峰，低光度下出现吸收状特征。高光度NuSTAR观测中检测到0.106 Hz的QPO及约53.9 keV的CRSF（对应约6.0 $\times$ 10$^{12}$ G磁场），低光度下无CRSF。两次NuSTAR观测均有6.4 keV铁K$\alpha$线，高光度下另有约6.9 keV的弱铁发射。Swift/XRT能谱可用吸收幂律加黑体描述。MeerKAT射电观测未检测到，给出严格的射电光度上限。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为脉冲轮廓随能量和光度的变化表明吸积几何发生变化；CRSF仅在较高光度下出现，反映吸积条件或磁场探测随光度的改变；MeerKAT的未检测结果说明1A 1118–61在观测时刻的射电发射很弱或不存在。根据摘要无法判断该研究对磁星或FRB等其它射电暂现源的直接关联。

title: PSRDISP: A novel approach to modeling dispersive processes in single-pulsar noise analysis using epoch-wise dispersion measures
summary: We present PSRDISP, a novel approach to modeling deterministic and stochastic dispersive processes in pulsar timing datasets using high-precision epoch-wise dispersion measure (DM) estimates, with a Gaussian Process-based approach. Unlike the conventional single-pulsar noise analysis methodology, which is applied to frequency-resolved times of arrival (ToAs) of pulses, this technique is applied to epoch-wise DMs which are derived from these ToAs. It can also be applied to wideband DMs measured simultaneously with wideband ToAs. Therefore, this framework provides a paradigm-agnostic approach to characterise single-pulsar dispersive processes. This method is expected to minimise the impact of achromatic red noise processes while characterising these dispersive effects. We substantiate the discussed technique with representative examples using simulated narrowband and wideband datasets with realistic noise injections. We found the recovery to be in close agreement with the injections, and agnostic to the estimation technique. Our method applies to pulsar timing experiments where precise, epoch-wise DM estimates are possible, such as the Indian Pulsar Timing Array. This technique can serve as a powerful diagnostic tool for validating single-pulsar noise analyses, which is crucial for precision pulsar timing experiments, such as Pulsar Timing Arrays.

AI.abstract_translation: 我们提出PSRDISP，一种使用基于高斯过程（Gaussian Process）的高精度逐历元色散量（DM）估计来建模脉冲星计时数据集中确定性和随机性色散过程的新方法。与单脉冲星噪声分析的传统方法（该方法应用于脉冲的频率分辨到达时间（ToAs））不同，该技术应用于由这些ToAs导出的逐历元DM。它也可以应用于与宽带ToAs同时测量的宽带DM。因此，该框架提供了一种与范式无关的方法来表征单脉冲星色散过程。预计该方法在表征这些色散效应的同时，能够最大限度地减少消色差红噪声过程的影响。我们使用带有现实噪声注入的模拟窄带和宽带数据集，用代表性示例来证实所讨论的技术。我们发现恢复结果与注入值非常吻合，并且与估计技术无关。我们的方法适用于能够进行精确逐历元DM估计的脉冲星计时实验，例如印度脉冲星计时阵列（Indian Pulsar Timing Array）。该技术可以作为验证单脉冲星噪声分析的强大诊断工具，这对于精密脉冲星计时实验（例如脉冲星计时阵列）至关重要。
AI.tldr: 该论文提出PSRDISP，一种基于高斯过程、应用于逐历元色散量（DM）而非频率分辨ToAs的单脉冲星色散建模方法。利用模拟窄带和宽带数据，该方法对注入的色散过程恢复良好，且与估计技术无关。
AI.motivation: 传统单脉冲星噪声分析应用于频率分辨ToAs，难以独立表征色散过程。论文旨在提出一种基于逐历元DM高斯过程建模的新框架，以在表征色散效应的同时最大限度减少消色差红噪声影响，并服务于精密脉冲星计时实验。
AI.method: 摘要未说明具体仪器，但描述了方法：基于高斯过程（Gaussian Process），利用高精度逐历元DM（由ToAs导出，也可为与宽带ToAs同时测量的宽带DM）建模确定性与随机性色散过程；使用带现实噪声注入的模拟窄带和宽带数据集进行验证，并检验对估计技术的无关性。
AI.result: 使用模拟窄带和宽带数据集，PSRDISP对注入的色散过程恢复结果与注入值非常吻合（close agreement），且与估计技术无关（agnostic to the estimation technique）。该方法可应用于如印度脉冲星计时阵列等具备精确逐历元DM估计的计时实验。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为PSRDISP提供了与范式无关的单脉冲星色散过程表征框架，可最小化消色差红噪声影响，并可作为验证单脉冲星噪声分析的强大诊断工具，对脉冲星计时阵列等精密计时实验至关重要。关于与磁星、FRB的联系，根据摘要无法判断。

title: Constraining reionization: Evidence from 21 cm limits and predictions for fast radio bursts
summary: In this thesis, I explore multiple constraints on the properties of early galaxies, the reionization history, and the global 21 cm signal. Specifically, I use upper limits on the 21 cm power spectrum measured by the HERA interferometer, current and future measurements of the global 21 cm signal, and forecasts for high redshift Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs). Firstly, I examine the influence of cosmic reionization on FRBs. They are recently discovered extra-galactic sources of strong radio signals, and the dispersion measure of these signals is sensitive to the ionization state of the intergalactic medium. This analysis has previously only been done for specific reionization models; I propose using a model-independent parameterization of reionization. I employ synthetic data of future FRB measurements at high redshifts z>5 to show that (i) the model-independent method removes a significant bias in the inferred optical depth, and (ii) that the observation of high-z FRBs can facilitate direct and model-independent measurements of the reionization history and associated cosmological parameters. Secondly, I use Bayesian methods for a model-independent parameterization of the sky-averaged 21 cm signal. One of the biggest challenges in that field is identifying the cosmological signal among other systematic contributions and foregrounds. In my work, I compare two model-independent methods to fit the 21 cm signal and to separate out the foregrounds: (i) a Gaussian Process modelling the foreground-orthogonal component of the data, and (ii) a spline-based FlexKnot interpolation utilising Bayesian evidence to find the simplest signal (agnostic of its cosmological or systematic nature) that fits the data. I apply these methods to both, a synthetic validation data set and the EDGES observations. I find that both methods fully recover the foreground-orthogonal component of the signal and that the FlexKnot method is able to separate the signal from the foreground in the synthetic data. Using this novel analysis I discover a set of four different shapes that can explain the EDGES observations, only one of which resembles the originally reported absorption signal. Finally, I derive constraints on the astrophysical properties of early galaxies using 21 cm power spectrum observations from the HERA telescope. I derive a likelihood function to compare the data with cosmological models, develop a neural network emulator to speed up the computation of those cosmological models and analyze the measurements of two HERA data releases. I derive constraints on astrophysical parameters based on semi-numerical models, in particular focusing on models with non-standard radio backgrounds. The main constraint I find is that early galaxies cannot simultaneously produce low X-ray and high radio emissions, as such scenarios would produce a signal larger than the upper limits set by HERA.

AI.abstract_translation: 在本论文中，我探讨了对早期星系性质、再电离历史以及全球21 cm信号的多重约束。具体而言，我使用了由HERA干涉仪测量的21 cm功率谱上限、当前及未来的全球21 cm信号测量，以及对高红移快速射电暴（FRBs）的预测。首先，我考察了宇宙再电离对FRBs的影响。FRBs是最近发现的河外强射电信号源，这些信号的色散量对星系间介质的电离状态很敏感。这一分析此前仅针对特定的再电离模型开展过；我提出使用一种模型无关的再电离参数化方法。我利用未来高红移z>5的FRB测量的合成数据来表明：(i) 这种模型无关的方法消除了在推断光学深度中的显著偏差，并且(ii) 高红移FRBs的观测可以促进对再电离历史及相关宇宙学参数进行直接且模型无关的测量。其次，我使用贝叶斯方法对天空平均的21 cm信号进行模型无关的参数化。该领域最大的挑战之一是在其他系统性贡献和前景中识别宇宙学信号。在我的工作中，我比较了两种模型无关的方法来拟合21 cm信号并分离前景：(i) 一种对数据的前景正交分量进行建模的高斯过程，以及(ii) 一种基于样条的FlexKnot插值，利用贝叶斯证据找到拟合数据的最简单信号（不论其是宇宙学的还是系统性的性质）。我将这些方法应用于一个合成验证数据集以及EDGES观测。我发现这两种方法都能完全恢复信号的前景正交分量，并且FlexKnot方法能够在合成数据中将信号与前景分离。利用这一新颖分析，我发现了一组四种不同的形状可以解释EDGES观测，其中只有一种类似于最初报道的吸收信号。最后，我使用来自HERA望远镜的21 cm功率谱观测来推导对早期星系天体物理性质的约束。我推导了一个似然函数来将数据与宇宙学模型进行比较，开发了一个神经网络仿真器来加速这些宇宙学模型的计算，并分析了两次HERA数据发布的测量结果。我基于半数值模型推导了对天体物理参数的约束，特别关注具有非标准射电背景的模型。我发现的主要约束是，早期星系不能同时产生低X射线和高射电发射，因为这样的情景会产生一个大于HERA所设定上限的信号。
AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过21 cm观测与高红移FRB预测，对早期星系性质、再电离历史和全球21 cm信号施加多重约束；发现HERA上限表明早期星系不能同时产生低X射线和高射电发射。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在从多个角度约束早期星系性质、再电离历史和全球21 cm信号，以解决此前分析仅针对特定再电离模型以及难以从系统性和前景中识别宇宙学信号等知识缺口。
AI.method: 使用HERA的上限与两次数据发布、未来z>5的FRB合成数据、EDGES观测；采用模型无关再电离参数化、高斯过程与FlexKnot插值、贝叶斯证据、似然函数及神经网络仿真器等分析方法。
AI.result: 模型无关FRB方法可消除推断光学深度中的显著偏差，并使高红移FRB能直接测量再电离历史；两种方法均恢复前景正交分量，FlexKnot在合成数据中分离信号，并发现四种可解释EDGES观测的形状（仅一种类似原吸收信号）；关键约束是早期星系不能同时产生低X射线与高射电发射，否则信号将超过HERA上限。

title: EMU Discovery of Thunder: A Bow-shock PWN Powered by PSR J1631─4722 Escaping the Nimbus SNR (G336.7+0.5)
summary: We report the discovery of a bow-shock pulsar wind nebula (PWN), dubbed Thunder, powered by the radio pulsar PSR J1631−4722 and projected within the Galactic supernova remnant (SNR) G336.7+0.5 (Nimbus). The system was first identified in observations from the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder Evolutionary Map of the Universe survey and further characterized using MeerKAT Galactic Plane Survey data, together with follow-up observations at 5.5 and 9 GHz obtained with the Australia Telescope Compact Array. Assuming a distance of 7 kpc, the radio images resolve an elongated ∼80″ (2.7 pc) cometary nebula, indicative of a high-velocity pulsar. An X-ray counterpart extending ∼50″ (1.7 pc) is detected in archival XMM-Newton data. The flat radio spectrum (α = −0.27 ± 0.05) and hard X-ray photon index (Γ = 1.6 ± 0.4) indicate synchrotron emission from relativistic particles injected in the pulsar wind. Polarization analysis reveals a highly ordered magnetic field aligned with the nebular flow, with fractional polarization reaching up to 30% in the tail. An equipartition estimate gives a PWN magnetic field strength of B<SUB>eq</SUB> ≍ 54─140 μG. Pulsar timing over a ∼2.2 yr baseline reveals strong timing noise and a small spin glitch with amplitude ∆ν/ν = 1.10 × 10<SUP>−8</SUP>. The SNR shows no clear diffuse X-ray counterpart. The morphology and multiwavelength properties of the Nimbus─Thunder system, together with evolutionary models, constrain the system age to ∼30─45 kyr, placing the remnant in the late Sedov phase, approaching the transition to the radiative stage.

AI.conclusion: 作者将Thunder解释为高速脉冲星驱动的弓形激波PWN，其平坦射电谱、硬X射线指数及有序偏振磁场表明相对论性粒子注入的同步辐射。结合形态、多波段性质与演化模型，系统年龄被约束在约30─45 kyr，使遗迹处于晚Sedov阶段、接近辐射阶段的过渡期。根据摘要无法判断该方法对其他类型源的普遍适用性。

title: The Southern-sky MWA Rapid Two-metre (SMART) pulsar survey-IV. Survey update and an atlas of 205 non-recycled southern pulsars
summary: The Southern-sky MWA Rapid Two-metre survey, which capitalises on the MWA's large field of view and voltage recording capability, is an ambitious effort to conduct sensitive searches for pulsars and fast transients in the 140--170 MHz band. The novelty of voltage recording, long dwell times (4 800 s), and the high-time and -frequency resolutions (100 μs/10-kHz) exchange a large survey speed (∼450°<SUP>2</SUP> h<SUP>-1</SUP>) for high computational cost. The survey covers the entire sky south of +30° in declination through a series of dedicated observing campaigns, accumulating nearly four petabytes of data. The large volumes of data and the processing challenges at low frequencies necessitate data processing to be approached in multiple phases, and the initial searches focused on a first-pass (shallow) survey of parts of the skies, as reported in earlier papers in this series. These data are also processed for re-detections of hundreds of known pulsars in the southern sky, many of which are also the first detections at frequencies below 400 MHz. This paper is motivated by the need to address the inherent difficulties (for the wider community) in handling large amounts of voltage data and software/processing challenges for routine pulsar detections and also by the fast-evolving landscape of the SKA Observatory (SKAO). With the construction and commissioning ramping up towards the full-scale SKA-Low, a low-frequency catalogue of detectable pulsars in the southern sky will prove to be a valuable reference for the science verification exercise. A growing sample of low-frequency pulsar detections and measurements will also prove invaluable in a variety of science applications including population studies, survey simulations, and emission beam models, refining interstellar medium models for electron densities and the spatial distribution of turbulence, and also for forecasting the detection prospects and survey yield from pulsar surveys planned with SKA-Low. We also present an electronic catalogue of various data products, including pulse profiles, time series, and multi-channel folded archives, along with the measurements of dispersion and rotation measures, and mean flux densities for the detected pulsars, and this will be periodically updated as more detections flow on from the ongoing data processing.
journal: Publications of the Astronomical Society of Australia

AI.abstract_translation: 南方天空MWA快速两米（SMART）巡天利用MWA的大视场和电压记录能力，是一项雄心勃勃的努力，旨在140–170 MHz频段内进行灵敏的脉冲星和快速暂现源搜索。电压记录、长驻留时间（4 800 s）以及高时间分辨率和频率分辨率（100 μs/10-kHz）的新颖之处在于，以很高的计算成本换取较大的巡天速度（∼450°² h⁻¹）。该巡天通过一系列专门的观测活动覆盖了赤纬+30°以南的整个天空，累积了近四拍字节的数据。大量的数据量以及低频下的处理挑战使得数据处理必须以多个阶段进行，而最初的搜索聚焦于部分天空的第一遍（浅）巡天，正如本系列早期论文所报告的那样。这些数据还用于重新探测南方天空数百颗已知脉冲星，其中许多也是在400 MHz以下频率的首次探测。本文的撰写动机是应对（对更广泛社区而言）在处理大量电压数据以及常规脉冲星探测的软件/处理挑战方面的固有困难，同时也有鉴于SKA天文台（SKAO）快速演变的格局。随着建设与调试逐步推进至全面规模的SKA-Low，一个南方天空可探测脉冲星的低频星表将证明是科学验证工作的重要参考。不断增长的脉冲星低频探测和测量样本也将在多种科学应用中证明其价值，包括种群研究、巡天模拟和发射波束模型，改进星际介质的电子密度和湍流空间分布模型，以及预测计划在SKA-Low上进行的脉冲星巡天的探测前景和巡天产额。我们还提供了一个各种数据产品的电子星表，包括脉冲轮廓、时间序列和多通道折叠档案，以及所探测脉冲星的色散量、旋转量的测量和平均流量密度，且随着持续数据处理中更多探测结果的产生，该星表将定期更新。
AI.tldr: SMART脉冲星巡天更新报告了南方天空低频（140–170 MHz）脉冲星探测的持续进展，并提供一个包含205颗非回收南方脉冲星数据产品的图谱，包括脉冲轮廓、时间序列、折叠档案、DM、RM和平均流量密度，为SKA-Low科学验证提供参考。
AI.motivation: 处理大量电压数据与低频软件/处理挑战对更广泛社区存在固有困难，且SKA-Low建设与调试正加速推进，需要一个南方天空可探测脉冲星的低频星表作为科学验证参考，并用于种群研究、巡天模拟及预测SKA-Low脉冲星巡天产额。
AI.method: 利用MWA大视场与电压记录能力，在140–170 MHz频段进行灵敏的脉冲星与快速暂现源搜索，驻留时间4 800 s，时间/频率分辨率为100 μs/10-kHz，巡天速度约450°² h⁻¹；覆盖赤纬+30°以南天空，累积近4 PB数据；采用多阶段处理，包含第一遍（浅）巡天及已知脉冲星的重探测。
AI.result: 调查覆盖赤纬+30°以南全部天空，累积近四拍字节数据；重探测到南方天空数百颗已知脉冲星，其中许多是400 MHz以下频率的首次探测；本文呈献一个电子星表，包含脉冲轮廓、时间序列、多通道折叠档案，以及DM、RM和平均流量密度测量，并随处理进展定期更新。
AI.conclusion: 该低频脉冲星星表将证明是SKA-Low科学验证工作的重要参考；不断增长的低频探测和测量样本可应用于种群研究与巡天模拟、改进星际介质电子密度和湍流分布模型，并用于预测SKA-Low脉冲星巡天的探测前景和巡天产额。

title: Implications of f(Q, T) gravity on formation of massive charged compact stars and estimation of their radii using recent observational constraints
summary: We present a new class of exact charged isotropic compact star solutions in the framework of f(Q, T) gravity, where the nonmetricity scalar Q is linearly coupled with the trace of the energy--momentum tensor T. The Einstein--Maxwell field equations are solved for a static, spherically symmetric interior by adopting physically motivated metric potentials, and the interior spacetime is smoothly matched to the exterior Reissner--Nordström geometry at the stellar boundary. The resulting solutions describe three families of configurations determined by the charge parameter N corresponding to 0 <= N < 1, <mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>N</mml:mi><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math>, and N > 1. Closed analytical expressions for the energy density, pressure, and electric charge are obtained and shown to satisfy all fundamental physical requirements for realistic compact stars, including regularity at the center, positive and monotonically decreasing thermodynamic quantities, causal sound speeds, and dynamical stability through the adiabatic index. The modified Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff equation further confirms that equilibrium is maintained through the combined action of gravitational, hydrostatic, electric, and matter--geometry coupling forces. The coupling parameters σ<SUB>1</SUB> and σ<SUB>2</SUB> significantly influence the internal stiffness and compactness of the stellar configuration. The predicted mass--radius relations are consistent with observational constraints from massive neutron stars and gravitational-wave sources such as PSR J0437-4715, PSR J1012+5307, PSR J0740+6620, PSR J0952-0607, and the mass-gap event GW190814. In particular, the model allows Pulsars-like objects with radii in the range [11.3 km, 17.5 km] and GW190814-like objects with radii in the range [13.5 km, 17.2 km]. Among the three configurations, the case N < 1 tends to produce higher masses and smaller radii with increasing σ<SUB>1</SUB>, while the case <mml:math><mml:mrow><mml:mi>N</mml:mi><mml:mo>=</mml:mo><mml:mn>1</mml:mn></mml:mrow></mml:math> permits comparatively larger radii as σ<SUB>2</SUB> increases, and the case N > 1 provides an intermediate behaviour between these two limits. Overall, the results indicate that f(Q, T) gravity offers a flexible and physically consistent framework for modelling ultra-dense compact stars compatible with current astrophysical observations.

title: Evolution of Calvera and descendants of Calvera-like central compact objects
summary: Calvera (1RXS J141256.0+792204) is an isolated neutron star recently classified as a central compact object (CCO) after its association with the supernova remnant (SNR) candidate G118.4+37.0. In this work, we investigate the long-term evolution and descendants of Calvera and the CCOs with similar initial conditions in the fallback disc model. We show that the observed spin period, period derivative, and X-ray luminosity of Calvera can be reproduced simultaneously with a magnetic field strength of <inline-formula><tex-math>$\simeq 4 \times 10^{10}$</tex-math></inline-formula> G at the pole of the neutron star at an age of <inline-formula><tex-math>$\sim 10^4$</tex-math></inline-formula> yr which is consistent with the estimated SNR age of the source. In the model, the lack of ordinary radio pulsations is due to ongoing mass accretion on to the star. From our simulations, we estimate that the source will become an ordinary radio pulsar (RP) after the termination of the accretion. The source will spin down under the weak dipole torque alone as an RP for a very long time (<inline-formula><tex-math>$\gtrsim 10^8$</tex-math></inline-formula> yr) after the inactivation of the disc. From our simulations, we find that most of the CCOs with initial conditions similar to those of Calvera also become RPs which remain above or close to the upper border of the pulsar death valley after the inactivation of their discs. In the period--period derivative diagram, there is indeed a cluster of RPs in the region where the descendants of Calvera-like CCOs are estimated to be located in our model.

title: Timing Gravity with Pulsars in the Strong Field
summary: We propose a novel approach for the timing of pulsars orbiting a supermassive black hole, which implements the fully relativistic calculations of the photon travel time into a robust timing model. We generate realistic mock catalogs of pulsar times of arrival for several putative pulsars on tight orbits around the Galactic Center supermassive black hole, Sagittarius A* (Sgr A*). Then, we perform a proof-of-concept sensitivity analysis to forecast the accuracy that future observational facilities, like the Square Kilometre Array, will achieve in the characterization of the parameters of our timing model. Our analysis shows how the observation of pulsars at the Galactic Center will open an incredibly promising avenue for the characterization of the physical properties of Sgr A*, which can improve by at least 3 orders of magnitude the current constraints on the black hole's mass achieved with S-stars and event-horizon scale observations.

title: Rapid quasi-periodic reconfiguration of the accretion column in pulsar 1A 0535+262
summary: Accretion onto strongly magnetised neutron stars is commonly interpreted using quasi-steady models, in which the accretion-column structure adjusts smoothly to the mass inflow rate. The cyclotron line in the X-ray spectrum, whose centroid energy traces the magnetic field strength and thus the height of the line-forming region, provides a key diagnostic of this structure. Whether this simple quasi-steady description remains valid on short dynamical timescales has remained uncertain. Here we show that, during a giant outburst of the X-ray pulsar 1A 0535+262, quasi-periodic hard X-ray flux variations are accompanied by synchronised oscillations of the cyclotron line energy, with amplitudes exceeding those expected from simple accretion-rate fluctuations. The anti-correlation between cyclotron energy and apparent flux provides direct spectral-timing evidence for rapid changes in the line-forming region, which we interpret as geometric reconfiguration of the accretion column. The variability emerges in the luminosity regime where radiation pressure becomes dynamically important. These results reveal limitations of a simple quasi-steady interpretation for this source and suggest that radiation-supported columns can enter intrinsically dynamical states in high-luminosity accreting pulsars.

title: Gamma-ray Emission from the Crab Pulsar: A 17 yr Fermi-LAT Reanalysis
summary: We present a reanalysis of 17 yr of Fermi Large Area Telescope (LAT) observations of the Crab pulsar obtained between 2008 August and 2025 August. Using monthly Jodrell Bank radio ephemerides, we assigned pulse phases to the LAT events and aligned the phase zero across the full data set. From this phase-aligned data set, we derived pulse profiles over 100 MeV-300 GeV, which remain clearly detectable in the 10-20 and 20-30 GeV bands with H-test significances of 32.36σ and 11.59σ, respectively, but are not significantly detected in the 30-300 GeV band. Phase-resolved likelihood analysis was performed over 100 MeV-30 GeV using 14 phase bins with comparable pulsed statistics. The fixed-window fractional fluxes show that the contribution of Peak 1 (P1) decreases steadily with energy, while those of Peak 2 (P2) and the Bridge increase, with P2 exceeding P1 above 10 GeV. Finally, the same phase-assignment framework also enables an off-pulse analysis from 100 MeV to 1 TeV, confirming the synchrotron and inverse-Compton components that dominate the emission in the selected off-pulse interval.

title: GRB 260317A: SVOM/ECLAIRs detection through offline targeted search and its possible association to magnetar 1E 1841-04.5
summary: The SVOM/ECLAIRs telescope detected GRB 260317A, also detected by Fermi/GBM (GCN 44041), starting at 2026-03-17T20:01:51.940 UTC (T0), through an offline targeted search with the event-by-event data downloaded via the X-band ground station. The burst was detected within several timescales and energy ranges. The best detection is obtained by the image trigger with a signal-to-noise ratio of 5.4 within 8-50 keV over a time window of 0.04 s starting at T0. This event was not detected onboard because it was too faint and too short. The ECLAIRs lightcurve shows a multi-peaked structure lasting around 0.04 s. The localization of the source is RA, Dec =280.383, -5.301 degrees: RA (J2000) = 18h41m32s Dec (J2000) = -05d18m04s with a 90% C.L. radius of 14.3 arcmin (including systematic error of 2 arcmin added in quadrature). This localization is broadly consistent with that reported by Fermi/GBM (GCN 44041). The angular separation between the two positions is 27.5 degrees, which is compatible with the 13.33 degrees 1-sigma statistical uncertainty of the GBM localization. The time-averaged spectrum from T0 to T0+0.04 s in the 5-120 keV is well fitted by a power law with a photon index of 1.1+/-0.2 and a corresponding 4-120 keV fluence of (6+/-1)e-8 erg/cm^2. Given the proximity (22 arcmin) of GRB 260317A to the magnetar 1E 1841-04.5 (also named PSR J1841-0456), and the possibly underestimated ECLAIRs positional uncertainties due to the very short duration of the burst, it is possible that GRB 260317A is actually a magnetar short burst. All quoted errors are at the 68% confidence level. The Space Variable Objects Monitor (SVOM) is a China-France joint mission led by the Chinese National Space Administration (CNSA), French Space Agency (CNES), and the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), which is dedicated to observing gamma-ray bursts and other transient phenomena in the energetic universe. ECLAIRs was developed jointly by APC, CEA, CNES, and IRAP. The SVOM/ECLAIRs point of contact for this event is : Hui Yang (hui.yang@cnrs.fr)

title: Investigation of Mode Changing and Subpulse Drifting Properties of Three New Pulsars Discovered by FAST
summary: Studying pulsars with interesting single-pulse emission features in depth is one of the main ways to understand how pulsar radiation works. In this paper, we present a detailed investigation of three newly discovered pulsars that show unusual single-pulse behavior, namely PSRs J1745−0059, J1800−0059, and J1801−0108. Using the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope, we reveal their unique single-pulse radiation properties. Our results show that J1745−0059 is a pulsar that exhibits both mode changing and nulling. We find that nulling events are fairly brief, and the overall nulling fraction is about 2.1% ± 0.3%. The pulsar also shows two distinct emission modes: 67% of the time it is in Mode A, and 33% of the time in Mode B. The key difference between the two modes is the strength of the trailing component, which is greater in Mode A. Moreover, during Mode A, the trailing component displays intensity modulation with a period of about 4.2 P ± 0.4 P, where P is the pulsar's spin period. For J1800−0059 and J1801−0108, we detect clear subpulse drifting, with modulation periods of P<SUB>3</SUB> = 5.0 P ± 0.4 P and P<SUB>3</SUB> = 19.9P ± 2.3 P, respectively. Furthermore, J1801−0108 may exhibit a reversed drift direction. Lastly, we obtain the polarization and geometric properties for all three pulsars.

title: Full analytic expressions of overlap reduction functions for anisotropies of the stochastic gravitational-wave background with pulsar timing arrays
summary: Recent findings collectively suggest that pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) have detected the stochastic gravitational-wave background in the nanohertz frequency band, opening new avenues for testing theories of gravity and cosmology. PTAs serve as a unique tool for probing the nanohertz stochastic gravitational-wave background, enabling studies of supermassive black hole evolution and early-Universe physics. PTA data analysis fundamentally relies on cross-correlating timing residuals from pulsar pairs, for which the overlap reduction functions (ORFs) are critical in determining the sensitivity of such analyses. Conventional ORF calculations based on the "short-wavelength approximation" break down when handling the scalar longitudinal polarization mode and fail to accurately describe frequency-dependent effects and anisotropies. This work presents a significant advance by rigorously deriving the full response functions within an analytical cross-correlation framework. We systematically reveal, for the first time, the intrinsic symmetries and mathematical relationships among the anisotropic ORF integrals for different polarization modes. Through variable substitutions and coordinate rotations, we transform the complex integrals into analytically tractable forms, resolving the divergence difficulties encountered in the vector and scalar longitudinal modes. Building on these theoretical advances, we establish a universal framework capable of deriving fully analytical expressions for anisotropic ORFs to arbitrary order for all six polarization modes. As a direct application of this framework, we provide complete analytical expressions for anisotropic ORFs up to the order of <inline-formula><mml:math><mml:mo>ℓ</mml:mo><mml:mo>≤</mml:mo><mml:mn>5</mml:mn></mml:math></inline-formula>. This universal framework is free from approximations; its (0,0) component naturally corresponds to the isotropic case and recovers the well-known Hellings-Downs curve. Compared to numerical integration, our results offer broader applicability, significantly faster computation, and higher precision. They provide a valuable theoretical and computational foundation for conducting high-precision anisotropic sky mapping, polarization-mode separation, and searches for new physics using PTA data.

AI.abstract_translation: 最近的研究结果共同表明，脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）已探测到纳赫兹频段的随机引力波背景，为检验引力理论和宇宙学开辟了新的途径。PTAs 作为探测纳赫兹随机引力波背景的独特工具，能够支持对超大质量黑洞演化和早期宇宙物理的研究。PTA 数据分析从根本上依赖于对来自脉冲星对的计时残差进行互相关，而重叠缩减函数（ORFs）对于确定此类分析的灵敏度至关重要。基于"短波长近似"的传统 ORF 计算在处理标量纵偏振模式时会失效，并且无法准确描述频率相关效应和各向异性。本工作通过在一个解析互相关框架内严格推导完整的响应函数，取得了一项重要进展。我们首次系统地揭示了不同偏振模式的各向异性 ORF 积分之间内在的对称性和数学关系。通过变量替换和坐标旋转，我们将复杂的积分转化为解析上可处理的形式，解决了矢量和标量纵模式中遇到的发散困难。基于这些理论进展，我们建立了一个普适框架，能够对全部六种偏振模式推导任意阶各向异性 ORF 的完全解析表达式。作为该框架的一个直接应用，我们提供了阶数达到 ℓ≤5 的各向异性 ORF 的完整解析表达式。该普适框架不包含近似；其 (0,0) 分量自然地对应于各向同性情形，并恢复出众所周知的 Hellings-Downs 曲线。与数值积分相比，我们的结果具有更广泛的适用性、显著更快的计算速度以及更高的精度。它们为利用 PTA 数据进行高精度各向异性天空制图、偏振模式分离以及寻找新物理提供了宝贵的理论和计算基础。
AI.tldr: 该工作提出了一个无近似的解析框架，可对全部六种偏振模式推导任意阶的各向异性重叠缩减函数（ORF），并给出了阶数达到 ℓ≤5 的完整解析表达式，其中 (0,0) 分量恢复出 Hellings-Downs 曲线，且相比数值积分更快速、更精确。
AI.motivation: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTAs）已探测到纳赫兹随机引力波背景，而 PTA 数据分析依赖对脉冲星对计时残差的互相关，重叠缩减函数（ORFs）决定其灵敏度。传统"短波长近似"的 ORF 计算在处理标量纵偏振模式时失效，且无法准确描述频率相关效应和各向异性，因此需要更严密的解析框架。
AI.method: 在解析互相关框架内严格推导完整的响应函数；通过变量替换和坐标旋转将复杂积分转化为解析可处理的形式，以解决矢量和标量纵模式的发散困难；系统地揭示不同偏振模式各向异性 ORF 积分的内在对称性和数学关系，从而建立可推导任意阶各向异性 ORF 的普适框架，并给出 ℓ≤5 阶的完整解析表达式。
AI.result: 该框架不包含近似，其 (0,0) 分量自然对应各向同性情形并恢复出 Hellings-Downs 曲线。文章首次揭示了不同偏振模式各向异性 ORF 积分之间的内在对称性和数学关系，解决了矢量和标量纵模式的发散困难，并提供了阶数达 ℓ≤5 的所有六种偏振模式的完整解析表达式；与数值积分相比，结果适用范围更广、计算更快、精度更高。
AI.conclusion: 作者认为该无近似的普适框架为利用 PTA 数据进行高精度各向异性天空制图、偏振模式分离以及寻找新物理提供了宝贵的理论和计算基础。该结论直接支持 PTA 数据分析方法学的进展；根据摘要无法判断其对脉冲星、磁星或快速射电暴（FRB）具体物理的转移性或相应解释。

title: GRB 260802A/EP J223759.5+531421: SVOM detection of a possible magnetar burst
summary: At 2026-08-02T09:23:10 UTC (T0), SVOM/ECLAIRs triggered and located the gamma-ray burst GRB 260802A (SVOM burst-id sb26080210). The following trigger information was received on the ground with low latency by the SVOM VHF Alert Network. The burst was only detected by the Count-Rate Trigger (CRT), which produced a sequence of 3 alerts. CRT provided the alert with the best signal-to-noise-ratio in the image (SNR) of 8.09 in the [5-20] keV energy band starting at 2026-08-02T09:23:10. The localization of the best alert is R.A., Dec. 339.4431, 53.2195 degrees (J2000) with a 90% confidence level (C.L.) radius of 9.72 arcmin (including systematic error of 2 arcmin added in quadrature). The SVOM/ECLAIRs showed a single peak structure. The duration of the best trigger time window is 40 ms (0.04 s).The best time window ranges from the given Tb+0.765 to Tb+0.805 s We note that the magnetar EP J223759.5+531421(Atel #17859) is located in ECLAIRs error box, and given the short and soft nature of the burst, we suggest it is associated with this newly discovered magnetar. SVOM slewed to the burst. SVOM/MXT began observing the field at 2026-08-02T09:25:42 UTC, 151 seconds after T0. Using onboard processed data we found a possible uncatalogued X-ray source with a low SNR, located at R.A., Dec. 339.439, 53.234 degrees: R.A. (J2000) = 22h37m45s Dec. title: Polarization, single-pulse variability, and short-timescale timing noise of seven millisecond pulsars
summary: Using the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical radio Telescope (FAST), we obtained high-quality polarization profiles for seven millisecond pulsars (MSPs). These include the first reported polarization profile for PSR J1933+1726, as well as the first determinations of Faraday rotation measures (RMs) for PSRs J1933+1726, J1932+1756, and J1914+0659. Single-pulse analysis of PSR J2053+4650 shows that the average profile, formed from bright pulses, exhibits weak bridge emission. Using Longitude-Resolved Fluctuation Spectrum (LRFS) analysis, we identified periodic intensity modulations in PSRs J2045+3633 and J2053+4650 for the first time. By decomposing the total white noise into its three principal components, namely radiometer noise, pulse jitter, and diffractive interstellar scintillation (DISS), we find that scintillation noise is negligible, contributing less than 10 % to the total white noise. The timing residuals of PSRs J2045+3633 and J2053+4650 are dominated by intrinsic pulse jitter, with σ<SUB>J</SUB>(1 h) ≍ 297 ns and 116 ns, respectively, whereas the other pulsars are radiometer-noise-limited. For these two jitter-dominated pulsars, we further investigated the frequency dependence of jitter and identified contrasting behaviors. We demonstrated that matrix template matching (MTM) using full Stokes parameters can effectively mitigate jitter noise.

AI.abstract_translation: 利用五百米口径球面射电望远镜（FAST），我们获得了七颗毫秒脉冲星（MSPs）的高质量偏振轮廓。其中包括PSR J1933+1726首次报道的偏振轮廓，以及PSR J1933+1726、J1932+1756和J1914+0659法拉第旋转量（RMs）的首次测定。对PSR J2053+4650的单脉冲分析表明，由亮脉冲形成的平均轮廓显示出微弱的桥接辐射。利用经度分辨涨落谱（LRFS）分析，我们首次在PSR J2045+3633和J2053+4650中识别出周期性的强度调制。通过将总白噪声分解为其三个主要分量，即辐射计噪声、脉冲抖动（pulse jitter）和衍射星际闪烁（DISS），我们发现闪烁噪声可以忽略不计，对总白噪声的贡献小于10%。PSR J2045+3633和J2053+4650的计时残差由固有的脉冲抖动主导，σ<SUB>J</SUB>(1 h) ≍ 297 ns 和 116 ns，而其他脉冲星则以辐射计噪声为限。对于这两颗以抖动为主的脉冲星，我们进一步研究了抖动的频率依赖性，并识别出截然不同的行为。我们证明，使用完整斯托克斯参数的矩阵模板匹配（MTM）可以有效减轻抖动噪声。
